stories.title: ESBEE appoints Sharad Kelkar for campaign
stories.summary: Real estate developer ESBEE has appointed actor Sharad Kelkar as brand ambassador for its new campaign, Spaces That Breathe. The company says the campaign explores how design shapes how people live and unwind. ESBEE has delivered 1 million sq ft of space with 2 million sq ft currently under construction.

stories.title: KFC India uses matchmaking tropes for chicken campaign
stories.summary: KFC India has launched a campaign film for its Korean Dunked range featuring a traditional matchmaking meeting. The narrative uses familiar family drama tropes to introduce the menu item, culminating in a scene where a piece of chicken is thrown across the room. Sauce is now a narrative device.

stories.title: LT Foods features Ranveer Brar in rice campaign
stories.summary: LT Foods has launched a marketing campaign for Delight Basmati rice featuring Chef Ranveer Brar. The film depicts an office lunchtime debate about the importance of rice in a meal. The company says the product is designed to absorb the flavours of accompanying dishes to enhance dining experiences.

stories.title: Sunfeast adds fibre to protein drink launch
stories.summary: ITC Foods has introduced a Sunfeast protein drink containing 25g of protein and 5.8g of fibre. The dairy-free beverage is priced at Rs 125 for a 300ml pack. While the company cites growing interest in protein, it notes that fibre has received comparatively less attention in the category.

stories.title: Campa Cola highlights festive prep in new campaign
stories.summary: Campa Cola has launched a festive campaign titled Tayyari Big, Tyohaar Bada Big. Conceptualised by McCann India, the film depicts various community preparations for festivals, including decorating homes and building effigies. The brand positions itself as a companion for the breaks taken during these activities.

stories.title: MakeMyTrip adopts Bonnie and Clyde theme for sale
stories.summary: MakeMyTrip has launched a campaign featuring Alia Bhatt and Ranveer Singh as a criminal couple to promote its Travel ka Muhurat Sale. The films show the pair discussing travel bookings between heists. The sale covers flights, hotels, villas, apartments, cabs and buses until the end of November.

stories.title: Emami brings back Madhuri Dixit for BoroPlus
stories.summary: Emami has appointed Madhuri Dixit as brand ambassador for BoroPlus Ayurvedic Antiseptic Cream. The winter campaign, produced by RH Films, focuses on everyday family care and positions the cream as a multi-purpose product for dry skin and minor cuts. The campaign is rolling out across national media.

stories.title: Luminous refreshes brand with Sachin Tendulkar
stories.summary: Luminous has launched a campaign featuring Sachin Tendulkar to promote a solar ecosystem powered by PoweriQ. The company introduced a new tagline, Har Soch Mein Power, to reflect its ambition for energy solutions. The campaign focuses on consumer demand for uninterrupted power and electricity bill savings.

stories.title: Jewelchic names actor Radhika Madan as brand ambassador to strengthen its 9KT gold positioning - The Retail Jeweller Ind
Madhuri Dixit returns to Emami for BoroPlus
stories.summary: Emami has named Madhuri Dixit as the brand ambassador for BoroPlus Ayurvedic Antiseptic Cream. The company launched a winter campaign titled A Perfect Gift for Family, produced by RH Films. The brand says the campaign is built around the truth that care lies in small everyday gestures.

Creativeland Asia wins D’YAVOL Spirits mandate
stories.summary: Creativeland Asia has been awarded the global creative mandate for D’YAVOL Spirits. The agency secured the account following a multi-agency pitch. It will now lead communications for the brand across India and several international markets.

stories.title: Hashtag Orange wins Safe Air Company mandate
stories.summary: Hashtag Orange has been appointed as the integrated marketing partner for The Safe Air Company to launch its Safe Air Haven product in Delhi NCR. The agency will manage brand awareness, lead generation and conversion. The mandate focuses on establishing the category of whole-home air protection.

stories.title: Tribes appoints Abhishek Kabra for strategic investments
stories.summary: Tribes has appointed Abhishek Kabra as head of strategic investments, acquisitions and compliance. Kabra, who has 22 years of experience in financial management and corporate strategy, will work with the leadership team to expand the company’s business through new capabilities and international markets.

stories.title: Ogilvy India appoints Anahita Brar as vice president
stories.summary: Anahita Brar has joined Ogilvy India WPP Open X as vice president and category lead. Brar brings 17 years of experience in advertising and account management, having previously held positions at Leo Burnett India, Dentsu Creative and MullenLowe Group Asia Pacific.

stories.title: CarDekho Group names Sudhir Pai as CEO
stories.summary: CarDekho Group has appointed Sudhir Pai as CEO of auto classifieds and group strategy head. Pai previously led Magicbricks for 15 years. He will now oversee the group's core auto-classifieds platforms, including CarDekho.com, ZigWheels and BikeDekho, while driving long-term growth priorities.

stories.title: WPP Media wins Branch International mandate
stories.summary: WPP Media has partnered with fintech company Branch International to manage performance marketing for its India business. The mandate focuses on digital customer acquisition and improving marketing efficiency through data and audience insights. The engagement includes developing customer journeys based on consumer behaviour.

stories.title: WPP Media wins performance-led customer acquisition mandate for Branch International
stories.summary: WPP Media has secured a mandate to manage performance marketing for Branch International in India. The partnership aims to drive customer acquisition by combining data and audience insights to build digital journeys. The fintech company provides mobile-first financial services and credit solutions across various emerging markets.

stories.title: WPP wins Bosch Home Comfort India creative mandate
stories.summary: WPP has been appointed to handle the creative mandate for Bosch and Hitachi air-conditioning brands in India. The agency group won the account following a competitive pitch involving BBDO, TBWA, and BBH. WPP is now tasked with developing distinct brand strategies for the two air-conditioning labels.

stories.title: Havas Media Network India bags media mandate for Milky Mist’s Capella
stories.summary: Havas Media Network India has won the integrated media mandate for Milky Mist’s luxury chocolate brand, Capella. The account will be managed by an integrated team from Havas Media India and PivotRoots. The agency continues to expand its client roster across the southern region of India.

stories.title: Viral Pitch appoints Adish Rai as Group President
stories.summary: Influencer marketing agency Viral Pitch has appointed Adish Rai as Group President to oversee revenue and client strategy. Rai joins from clean beauty brand Soulflower, where he managed growth across retail and digital channels. The company is currently looking to expand its enterprise partnerships.

stories.title: Imtiyaz Vilatra takes on expanded role at dentsu India
stories.summary: Dentsu India has appointed Imtiyaz Vilatra as chief commercial officer, adding to his existing leadership role as CEO of Posterscope. He will work across the network to improve the profitability of client relationships and drive performance. The role focuses on deepening partnerships and ensuring measurable value for investments.

stories.title: WPP Media Wins Branch International’s Performance Marketing Mandate in India - IMPACT Magazine
Meesho partners with YouTube Shopping to expand creator affiliate opportunities
stories.summary: Meesho has partnered with YouTube Shopping to allow creators with at least 500 subscribers to tag products in long-form videos and Shorts. Creators can earn commissions on purchases from a catalogue of 30 million items. The platform aims to turn content into a direct sales channel.

stories.title: Meesho partners with YouTube Shopping to boost creator commerce
stories.summary: Meesho is integrating its catalogue of 30 million affiliate products into YouTube Shopping. Creators with 500 subscribers can now tag products in videos to earn commissions on sales. The partnership provides a new way for creators to build income through product recommendations and audience engagement.

stories.title: IPLIX Media says brands are paying premiums for influencer exclusivity
stories.summary: Brands are paying 10 to 30 percent more to secure exclusivity deals with influencers, according to IPLIX Media co-founder Jag Chima. The industry is seeing a renewed push for long-term relationships where creators are paid a premium to avoid endorsing competing products in the same category.

stories.title: AI likeness licensing emerges as a new influencer revenue stream
stories.summary: Influencer contracts are beginning to include separate fees for the use of digital replicas. Industry executives report a growing divide between established creators with negotiating power and smaller influencers who have less control over how their faces and voices are commercially exploited by brands using artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Matilda Djerf says Djerf Avenue is reducing reliance on its founder
stories.summary: Influencer Matilda Djerf says her fashion brand, Djerf Avenue, is now producing campaigns without her participation. The company has hired an external CEO to lead operations. Djerf noted that some customers in the brand's New York store do not know she is the founder.

stories.title: iShowSpeed gets Obama’s approval to release documentary for free
stories.summary: Influencer iShowSpeed asked former President Barack Obama for permission to release the documentary The Eyes of Ghana for free on his YouTube channel. Obama, an executive producer on the film, called the request a great idea. The channel currently has more than 62 million subscribers.

stories.title: YouTube adds estimated TV co-views to public metrics
stories.summary: YouTube now includes estimated co-views in public view counts for videos watched on shared TV screens. Previously, the platform only counted these as a single view. The company says its model now estimates how many people are watching together in the same living room.

stories.title: Hearst launches creator studio for branded content
stories.summary: Hearst Communications has launched Hearst Creator Studios to produce original content and brand deals. The unit involves more than 50 creators across editorial brands including Cosmopolitan and Elle. The studio functions as a hybrid between a talent agency and a creator network to execute media on the fly.

stories.title: YouTube partners with Rockstar Games for GTA VI launch
stories.summary: YouTube is partnering with Rockstar Games for a 24-hour livestream to mark the release of Grand Theft Auto VI. The broadcast will feature gameplay and creator content. The event begins on November 19 and includes on-the-ground coverage from Miami alongside various platform creators.

stories.title: CAA signs YouTuber Dami Lee and Nollistudio
stories.summary: Creative Artists Agency has signed architect-turned-YouTuber Dami Lee and her production company, Nollistudio. Lee, who creates videos about urban design and architecture, has 2.5 million subscribers. The agency will work with the team to expand their business and presence within the creator economy.

stories.title: Agencies push for AI clauses in influencer contracts
stories.summary: Influencer contracts in India are increasingly addressing the use of artificial intelligence to recreate a creator's likeness. Agencies are pushing for separate licensing fees and consent requirements. The debate remains experimental as brands evaluate whether original endorsement fees should cover the right to generate future AI performances.

stories.title: MrBeast says viewers are tired of repeated game formats
stories.summary: Jimmy Donaldson, known as MrBeast, said viewers are tired of the same game formats on his channel. The comments appeared in behind-the-scenes footage filmed after his channel surpassed 500 million subscribers. Donaldson acknowledged that his team is working on new content strategies to address the feedback.

stories.title: Meta pauses Facebook ad terms over AI data scraping rules
stories.summary: Meta halted controversial policy updates that would have allowed the company to scrape publisher websites and train AI models on merchant data without explicit consent. The changes were initially planned for October 30, 2026, but were paused following backlash from publishers, regulatory bodies, and the public.

stories.title: YouTube Shopping launches in Australia with Amazon
stories.summary: YouTube launched its affiliate program in Australia, allowing creators to tag products from Amazon.com.au directly inside content. The company says it is unlocking more commercial pathways for creators to build diversified businesses. Viewers can now shop without leaving the video player.

stories.title: YouTube launches shopping affiliate program in Australia
stories.summary: YouTube is officially launching its shopping affiliate program in Australia to bring native, in-player shopping to local screens. The company says it is taking the next major step to supercharge the creative economy. It follows nearly two decades of building tools for creators to turn passions into careers.

stories.title: YouTube expands AI-powered creative chatbot to all mobile users - Social Media Today
Instagram adds Amazon affiliate links to Reels and feed posts
stories.summary: Instagram now allows U.S. creators in Amazon’s influencer program to attach affiliate links to Reels and feed posts. Users can include up to 30 products per Reel and 20 per post. The company says it does not take a cut of the earnings generated by creators.

stories.title: X tests adding professional histories to user profiles
stories.summary: X is testing a new work experience element for user profiles. The experiment is reminiscent of the company’s previous attempt to build out X Jobs two years ago.

stories.title: YouTube adds music generation and comment controls
stories.summary: YouTube is testing a tool that allows creators to generate royalty-free instrumental tracks to replace copyright-protected audio in videos. The platform is also testing a bulk moderation option for comments, intended to help channel managers handle replies based on broader conversational context.

stories.title: YouTube's video tests will give creators seven days to pick a winning cut - PPC Land
YouTube clips tool now turns podcast episodes into Shorts
stories.summary: YouTube has expanded its video clips tool to allow creators to turn segments of long-form videos, such as podcast episodes, into vertical Shorts. Each Short created with the tool includes a clickable link to the original source video.

Dentsu slashes growth guidance after Q3 revenue decline
stories.summary: Dentsu organic revenue fell 3.7 percent in Q3, leading the holding company to cut its full-year growth guidance to negative 1 percent. CEO Takeshi Sano attributed the performance to weak macro conditions and client losses, citing AI transformation as the path forward.

Clinch receives two industry awards for AI marketing platform
stories.summary: Clinch won the Newsweek AI Impact Award and Best Marketing Technology Solution at The Wires. The company describes itself as an agentic operating system for omnichannel advertising that connects creative, data, and media. The platform is now officially decorated for its ability to manage campaigns across channels.
